Official Academy History

About Nisir Football Academy

Building future leaders through athletic excellence and mental toughness since 2013 E.C.

Established 2013 E.C. • Adama, Ethiopia

Our Founding Story (2013 E.C.)

Nisir Football Academy was established in 2013 E.C. (during the COVID-19 pandemic period) in Adama at Chapi Meda. When schools closed and students were confined at home, the founders recognized the heavy psychological strain, anxiety, and idle screen time burdening local youth.

Under strict health precautions and hygiene protocols, Coach Fisha Welde Meskel gathered a passionate initial cohort of young players to train on the pitch. Football became a sanctuary for mental health, physical vitality, and communal hope.

Timeline & Emblem Heritage

While the academy emblem preserves the historical "Since 2012" foundational roots, official team operations and structured youth cohort training at Chapi Meda commenced in 2013 E.C. (2020 G.C.) during the COVID-19 pandemic.

Chapi Stadium • 2013 E.C.Initial cohort training with discipline and hope.

The Nisir Creed

"A Better Dream for a Better Life"

We believe sport is not a distraction from school — it is the greatest teacher of focus, time management, and moral strength.

Our Foundation

Our Mission & Values

To develop elite technical football talent while instilling unwavering academic diligence, ethical sportsmanship, and life skills in every young trainee.

Uncompromising Discipline

Uncompromising standard on punctuality, respectful behavior, and focus on and off the pitch.

Academic Priority (School First)

Mandatory ranking criteria (1st-5th in class for U10, 1st-10th for U13, up to 90% school average). School comes first.

Integrity & Respect

Nurturing honest, respectful young leaders who represent Adama and their families with pride.

Brotherhood & Teamwork

Fostering lifelong brotherhood and mutual support among teammates from diverse backgrounds.
